title: New Evidence on Stock Price Effects Associated with Changes in the S&P 500 Index
one_line: After S&P began pre-announcing index changes (Oct 1989), additions earned significant positive (deletions negative) abnormal returns between announcement and effective date, only partly reversed afterwards.

findings.statement: Significant post-announcement abnormal returns: + for additions, − for deletions.
Only partly reversed after the effective date.

reported_results.headline: After S&P began pre-announcing index changes (Oct 1989), additions earned significant positive (deletions negative) abnormal returns between announcement and effective date, only partly reversed afterwards.

tradable_edge: Stock-level; effect has since largely disappeared (Greenwood & Sammon 2025).
data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
